title: Exploded Floor Assembly
description: Reusable SVG floor assembly showing dimensioned finish, screed, slab geometry, service void, and ceiling board with adjustable exploded spacing.
learningObjectives: Identify the vertical order and thickness of common floor assembly layers.
Distinguish physical build-up from display-only exploded separation.
Compare solid layer thickness with service-void depth without implying structural or code compliance.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: Candidate implementation includes deterministic thickness arithmetic and source review. Independent live-browser, visual, accessibility, and engineering review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Reserved buildings-agent task bld-floor-assembly; implemented as original dependency-free SVG/DOM source.
